rows.en:
Annihilate all enemies
Protect the defense target
Annihilate all enemy units
rows.notes: Stock objective style per u0201 / u0329.

rows.en: Reach the designated area
Defeat Golg Boddole Zer
rows.notes: Japanese uses the alias Gorugu Bodoruza; glossary en Golg Boddole Zer.

rows.en:
I'll be handling your Valkyrie flight training.
I look forward to working with you.
Let's go over the basics of Fighter mode.

During training, the controller settings
will be reset to their defaults,
so please be careful.
Press Left or Right on the D-pad to turn.

Press Up on the D-pad to nose down and
descend, and Down to nose up and climb.

Press the × button to boost.
You can keep boosting until
the Boost Gauge maxes out.
rows.notes: Boost Gauge rises while boosting (cf. u0935), hence 'until it maxes out'.

rows.en:
Quickly press Up, Left or Right on the D-pad
twice in the same direction to roll
that way.

Quickly press Down on the D-pad twice to fire
reverse thrusters and brake hard.

Push the analog stick up
to transform into Fighter mode.

That covers the basics of Fighter mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than Fighter.

Now go ahead and begin your
Fighter mode flight training.

Training ends when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
Let's go over the basics of Battroid mode.

Press Up, Down, Left or Right on the D-pad
to move forward, back, left or right.

Quickly press the D-pad twice in the same
direction to step that way.

At the end of a step, keep holding the D-pad
to dash.
Press the × button to jump.

Quickly press the × button twice
and keep holding it to
boost downward and lose altitude.
You can dash even in mid-jump.

Push the analog stick down
to transform into Battroid mode.

That covers the basics of Battroid mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than Battroid.

Now go ahead and begin your Battroid
mode training.
Let's go over the basics of GERWALK mode.
Press Left or Right on the D-pad to turn.

At the end of a step,
keep holding the D-pad to dash.

Hold the × button to boost upward
and gain altitude.

In GERWALK mode, you hold your altitude
and hover.

Quickly press the × button twice
and keep holding it to boost downward
and lose altitude.

Push the analog stick left or right
to transform into GERWALK mode.

That covers the basics of GERWALK mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than GERWALK.

Now go ahead and begin your
GERWALK mode training.

I'm in charge of your Valkyrie attack training.
I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Instructor's 'yoroshiku tanomu' rendered 'I'm counting on you' (subject restored). 'Attack training' covers the shooting and melee drills.

rows.en: I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.

During training, the controller settings
will be at their defaults. Watch out for that.
Press the R button to lock on to an enemy.
rows.notes: Japanese ends on a terse noun; written as a full imperative.

rows.en:
Press the L and R buttons together
to release the lock-on.

Press the □ button to attack the locked-on
enemy with your main weapon.

Press the ○ button to attack the locked-on
enemy with your special weapon.

On units with multiple special weapons,
hold the L button and press □
to switch special weapons.

Some special weapons are capable of
multi-lock-on, locking onto several
enemies at once!

For multi-lock-on, hold down
the ○ button to lock onto
multiple enemies within range.

Release the ○ button during multi-lock-on
to hit every enemy locked at that moment
with your special weapon!

These shooting attack controls
are the same in Fighter, Battroid
and GERWALK modes.
That covers the basics of shooting attacks.

Training is over when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.

Press the △ button to make a melee attack.
You can melee attack in any mode.

In Battroid and GERWALK modes,
press the △ button repeatedly
to chain a combo attack.

The number of combo hits
varies by unit and mode!

Hold the △ button for a while, then
release it for a charged-up melee attack.
rows.notes: Hold-and-release melee (tame kakutou) rendered 'charged-up melee attack', kept distinct from the glossary 'Charge Melee' (L + triangle, costs SP).

rows.en:
In Battroid and GERWALK modes,
press the △ button while dashing
for a dash melee attack.

In Battroid mode, press the △ button
to hit a downed enemy with a down attack.
rows.notes: 'down attack' = attack on a knocked-down enemy; no glossary term.

rows.en: That covers the basics of melee attacks.

Training's over when you reach
the target area or time runs out!

I'll be handling your Valkyrie special
maneuvers training. Nice to meet you!
Let me explain the special maneuvers.

During training, the controller settings
will be at their defaults, so be careful.

In Fighter mode, while locked on to an enemy,
hold the L button and you'll turn
to keep the enemy dead ahead.

In Battroid mode, hold
the L button to guard.
Guarding reduces the damage you take.

While guarding, press
Up, Left or Right on the D-pad to move
without dropping your guard.

Guarding also resets the camera angle
to face forward.

If you have a wingman,
combine the SELECT button and D-pad
to issue tactical commands.
rows.notes: Sakusen command rendered 'tactical commands'; no glossary term.

rows.en:
Hold the L button and press ○ to
use 1 block of the SP Gauge for
a Charge Shot.

Hold the L button and press △ to
use 1 block of the SP Gauge
for a Charge Melee.

Press △ and ○ together to
use 3 blocks of the SP Gauge for
a powerful Special Attack.

Press □ and × together to
use a set amount of the SP Gauge for
the pilot's own Command Skill.

Hold the L button and press △ and
○ together to perform a Combo Special
Attack with your wingman.
rows.notes: Combo Special Attack: glossary Combo SP Attack with the tutorial spelling 'Special Attack'.

rows.en:
A Combo Special Attack uses
6 blocks of the SP Gauge.
Those are the basic special maneuvers.

Training's over when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
Let me explain container transport.

During training, the controller settings
will be at their defaults,
so be careful.

Lock on to a container and move
close to it to pick it up.

You can't carry containers unless
you're in GERWALK or Battroid mode,
so watch out.
Press the □ button to set the container down.
That's all for container transport.

Training's over once you bring the container
to the designated point, reach the target
area, or run out of time.
